testcase.name: AP04 ~/.cursor/mcp.json:1

failure.message: MCP server installed from an unpinned package: w: npx web-mcp

testcase.failure: Why: npx/uvx/bunx fetch the newest version at every start. A hijacked or malicious update becomes code running with your agent's access, with no review. Fix: Pin an exact version (for example pkg@1.4.2), or install it once from a reviewed lockfile. https://braceframework.org/anti-patterns/#ap04-mcp-server-installed-from-an-unpinned-package

testcase.name: AP06 ~/.claude/settings.json:1

failure.message: Agent allowed to run any shell command: allow "Bash"

testcase.failure: Why: An allow-rule like Bash(*) or a bare Bash lets the agent run any command without asking. That includes curl to send your files out, rm -rf and git push --force. Fix: Allow only the specific commands the task needs, such as Bash(npm test), and keep deny rules for network and destructive commands. https://braceframework.org/anti-patterns/#ap06-agent-allowed-to-run-any-shell-command
